October, 2025
 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Gwl:24912

In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
 Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Rajesh Kumar Gupta
 On The 7 th Of October, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 43424 of 2025
 Ganesh Meena Rawat
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Ram Kumar Sharma - Advocate for the applicant.

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Smt. Ankita Mathur - Public Prosecutor for the respond  ORDER
This is first application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of the BNSS for grant of regular bail.

The applicant has been arrested on 27.05.2025 in connection with Crime No.105/2025 registered at Police Station Kotwali, District Sheopur for offence under Section 419, 420, 467, 468,
471 of IPC and under Section 3/4 of Pariksha Adhiniyam.

2. The allegation against the applicant is that in place of Aman (original candidate) the present applicant appeared during the recruitment process in the Constable Recruitment Examination,
2023, by falsifying biometrics in the Aadhar Card.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.
He is in custody since 27.05.2025.
Since charge-sheet has already been filed and investigation is over, therefore, there is no requirement of further custodial interrogation of the applicant.

It NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:24912 2 MCRC-43424-2025 is alleged that other co-accused persons have already been enlarged the benefit of regular bail by this Court in M.Cr.C. No.39934/2025 and M.Cr.C.No.41480/2025 respectively.
He is having no criminal antecedents.
Applicant is the permanent resident of District - Sheopur (M.P.) and there is no possibility of his absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence, if released on bail.

Hence,
prayed for grant of bail to the applicant.
4. On the other hand, learned State counsel vehemently opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.

sentences.text: 5. Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary.

6. Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) along with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/Committal Court.
Certified copy as per rules.
